h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Bhavnagar

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Bhavnagar

items.pText: Bhavnagar is a port city on the Gulf of Khambhat in Saurashtra, Gujarat, with the Alang ship-breaking yards along the coast to the south. FunPlay Systems is about 280 km away at Vasai, so we supply Bhavnagar's schools, housing societies, industrial units and municipal gardens regularly by road. Our installation team or a dealer in Gujarat sets up the equipment on site.

Coastal Saurashtra is dry for much of the year and hot in summer, and sea breezes carry salt across the city. Salt air is the main threat to metal outdoors here. Our posts are galvanised, so the zinc coating protects the steel underneath, and our slides, panels and seats are roto-moulded plastic that does not rust. Painted mild steel equipment, by contrast, often starts flaking within a season or two near the sea.

richText.heading: Materials that last in Bhavnagar's salt air

c: When comparing quotes, ask each supplier whether the pipes are galvanised or only painted. Paint chips with use, and once bare steel is exposed to salty air, rust spreads under the paint.

items.q: Why choose galvanised steel near the sea?
items.a: The zinc coating on galvanised steel protects the metal from salt air. Painted steel rusts once the paint chips, and on the coast that can happen quickly.

items.q: How far is Bhavnagar from your factory?
items.a: About 280 km. Our factory is in Vasai East, near Mumbai. We send equipment to Bhavnagar by road and install it with our team or a dealer in Gujarat.

items.q: How should we clean playground equipment on the coast?
items.a: Rinse it with fresh water every few weeks to remove salt, wipe slides and seats with a soft cloth, and check swing chains and fixings during a monthly inspection.
